name: Malus domestica
description: The common apple: a deciduous tree with pink and white blossom in spring and crisp fruit for eating fresh, cooking or making cider. Many varieties are sold.
care_note: Pests and diseases are common, so the fruit often needs protecting.

name: Pyrus communis
description: The common pear: a deciduous tree with white blossom in spring and sweet, fragrant, teardrop-shaped fruit. Many varieties are sold.
care_note: Pests and diseases are common, so the fruit often needs protecting.

name: Prunus persica
description: A deciduous fruit tree with pink or white blossom in spring. Its cultivars give peaches and nectarines.

toxic.note: The kernels inside the stones contain cyanide compounds, and wilted leaves are harmful too. Please do not eat or crush the kernels, and keep pets from chewing the stones and leaves.

name: Prunus domestica
description: A deciduous large shrub or small tree with white blossom in spring and purple stone fruit, eaten fresh, cooked or dried as prunes.

toxic.note: It is harmful to cats and dogs. Please keep pets from chewing the leaves, stems and stones.

name: Prunus salicina
description: A small fruit tree that blossoms earlier than European plums and ripens its fruit earlier in summer. It needs less winter chill, and most plums sold are its cultivars.

toxic.note: It is harmful to cats and dogs. Please keep pets from chewing the leaves, stems and stones.

name: Prunus armeniaca
description: A deciduous fruit tree with pink or white blossom in spring and fruit that is eaten fresh, dried or cooked.

toxic.note: The kernels inside the stones contain cyanide compounds. Please do not eat or crush the kernels, and keep pets from chewing the stones.

name: Ananas comosus
description: A slow-growing, clump-forming tropical plant with spiny, strap-like leaves and a central flower spike that becomes the fruit.

toxic.note: The juice can irritate sensitive skin, and the leaves are sharp. Please wear gloves when handling the plant.

name: Citrus × paradisi
description: A small evergreen citrus tree, often with sharp thorns, grown for its large grapefruit.

name: Citrus × aurantiifolia
description: A vigorous large shrub or small tree with very juicy, aromatic limes that ripen from green to yellow.

name: Eriobotrya japonica
description: An evergreen tree with large, leathery, veined leaves and white flowers in autumn and winter, followed by edible fruit. Frost below about −2 °C kills the flowers and young fruit.
edible: fruit flesh, raw or in jams

toxic.note: The seeds contain cyanide compounds and are poisonous if many are cracked and eaten. Please eat only the flesh.

name: Citrus glauca
description: A thorny inland shrub or small tree with bluish leaves and small, strongly flavoured limes. It suckers into thickets and dislikes humidity and wet feet.
